generator.public_stream: random.Random(seed): a regime of risk_allocation_contracts.CELLS (its ranges; its client charge ignored), a playbook it allows, then each public range in risk_allocation_contracts.draw_world's order and rounding
generator.turnkey_price: round to $10k of (the prior-weighted least joint cost over the 600 agreements + floor margin + the drawn turnkey offset)
